role: next-word suggestions and word completion after any number of typed letters, plus byte-level scoring
architecture: Minimal Inference Cellular Automaton with learned integer rewrite rules, quantized integer readout, an integer byte-memory sidecar (64-byte window), and integer word readouts over the 240 cellular probes at the current position and at the starts of the previous 2 words, plus 16 MICA rule ticks per word readout (32 pages x 256 candidates, six +-1 scoring terms, VSET of six learned integers) whose terms read a fixed 16-value code of each of the previous three words (a hash of the word) and the current probes
byte_part: Byte model and memory unchanged from v0.3.7/v0.3.5
training: Existing prefix2 context coefficients and biases refit on original training text, with corrected TinyStories/conversation/everyday source labels, bounded integer updates and training-only SWA. Native byte model/memory, next-word head, word-rule arrays, vocabulary and geometry unchanged.
selection: Fixed candidate selected before this direct-public037 qualification. Existing frozen word-stage confirmation reused transparently; matched clean sets used for reporting only; no clean retuning.
confirmation: See evidence/comparison.json and RELEASE_NOTES.md. Conditional two-letter word completion only; no byte-loss, next-word, sentence or ToM gain.
completion_policy: 9:7 existing prefix2:next integer score blend; TRAIN-calibrated probability gain12/16
